**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The APCN 2 Construction & Maintenance Agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Teleglobe USA Inc. I checked:

- **Targeted searches** for "compet", "restrict", "exclusiv", "shall not", and "other cable system" surfaced no covenant limiting the businesses we may operate or our participation in competing cable systems.
- **The planner's candidates (12.20 / 12.22)** are permissive and run in our favour — Parties may sell IRUs and make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions."
- **Paragraph 11.2** expressly contemplates other cable systems sharing APCN 2 Terminal Stations, confirming no exclusivity.
- **Subparagraph 17.4** is a restraint on the *Terminal Parties* (not to impede Direct Access) — a counterparty obligation benefiting us, correctly not flagged.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as a deviation: Subparagraphs 12.1 and 12.6–12.15 condition how Allocated Capacity may be used (carrier-only use, affiliate transfer conditions). These are internal asset-use rules of a jointly owned consortium cable, apply symmetrically to all Parties, and are expressly relaxed under 12.15/12.20/12.22 — they do not restrain our wider business.
